annotation.title_clean: 自動運転の公道実証実験に係る基準緩和認定制度について（申請手続・記載例）
annotation.title_en: Standard Relaxation Approval System for Public-Road Demonstration Experiments of Automated Driving (Application Procedures and Examples)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism (MLIT), Japan
annotation.summary_en: This slide deck from Japan's transport ministry (MLIT) explains how to apply for an exemption from vehicle safety standards (the "standard relaxation approval system") when running public-road trials of automated vehicles, remote-operated vehicles and walking-speed delivery robots. It covers the approval conditions, the required alternative safety measures, worked examples of application forms, and regional contact offices.
key_provisions_or_claims: Since February 2017, automated-vehicle trials can be exempted from all vehicle safety standards except exhaust and noise rules, if alternative safety measures such as speed and route limits are in place.
Since April 2020, the system has also covered motorised bicycles (原動機付自転車), which allows trials of automated delivery robots.
Walking-type robots trialled at up to 6 km/h in pedestrian areas are treated as Class 1 motorised bicycles.
Applicants must show how the vehicle meets each safety-standard clause, or what alternative safety measure replaces it, and sign a compliance pledge.
Applications are handled by MLIT and its regional transport bureaus.
